subject.title: fix(memory): honor qmd search timeout and bound one-shot CLI cleanup

question: Which conflicting implementation should be refreshed as the single canonical fix for the QMD timeout issue?
rationale: The competing PR is technically preferable and maintainer-repaired, but it is currently conflicting, so automation cannot safely close this branch until a maintainer chooses and restores one viable landing path.

options.title: Refresh the maintainer-repaired PR
options.body: Rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95757 and retain its command-phase deadline design without shared SDK expansion.

options.title: Adopt this branch instead
options.body: Rebase this PR only if maintainers explicitly accept whole-search budgeting and the new shared manager timeout and cleanup contract.

recommendation.title: Refresh the maintainer-repaired PR
recommendation.body: Rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95757 and retain its command-phase deadline design without shared SDK expansion.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and are assigned to the maintainer-repaired competing implementation, making them the clearest owner for consolidation.
